title: fix: resolve CI build errors across service packages, CLI, and app-crm
body:
CI failing on `main` due to four independent build errors: unused variable in service-cache, broken tsconfig inheritance in all service packages, stale `@ts-expect-error` in CLI, and missing interface files in app-crm example.

### tsconfig `exclude` inheritance (service-cache, service-job, service-queue, service-storage)

Service package tsconfigs inherited root `exclude: ["packages"]`, which resolved to `../../../packages` relative to the child config—excluding their own `src` directory. Added local `exclude: ["node_modules", "dist"]` override to match other working packages.

```jsonc
// Before: inherits root exclude which matches ../../../packages (self)
{ "extends": "../../../tsconfig.json", "include": ["src"] }

// After: local exclude prevents self-exclusion
{ "extends": "../../../tsconfig.json", "include": ["src"], "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist"] }
```

### TS6133: unused `defaultTtl` in `redis-cache-adapter.ts`

`defaultTtl` was assigned in constructor but never read. Included it in the `get()` error message alongside the existing `url` and `keyPrefix` references.

### TS2578: stale `@ts-expect-error` in `packages/cli/src/utils/studio.ts`

The `duplex` property on `RequestInit` is now recognized by current TypeScript types. Removed the unnecessary directive.

### Missing interface files in `examples/app-crm`

`src/interfaces/index.ts` re-exported from three `.interface.ts` files that were never created. Cleared the broken exports since `InterfaceSchema` was removed from the spec.
